data.desc: Nexalin designs and develops innovative neurostimulation products to uniquely help combat the ongoing global mental health epidemic. Nexalin's medical devices are non-invasive and designed to be undetectable to the human body. Nexalin products are developed to provide relief to those afflicted with mental health issues using frequency based bioelectronic medical technology. Nexalin believes its neurostimulation medical devices can penetrate structures deep in the mid-brain that are associated with mental health disorders. Nexalin's next-generation devices use a deeper-penetrating waveform designed to enhance patient response with a favorable tolerability profile, which continues to be evaluated in clinical studies. The Nexalin Gen-2 15 milliamp neurostimulation device has been approved in China, Brazil and Israel. Additional information about the Company is available at: https://nexalin.com/ .
